description: At an outdoor farm show under a cloudy blue sky, a big pink pig wearing prize rosettes and a PRIZE WINNER sash leaps high out of a show ring covered in wood shavings, its rope trailing behind. A young woman in a white coat dives after it and lands on her knees. The pig lands, scrambles over the edge of the ring and runs off past the camera, while the woman gets up laughing. Older men in tweed jackets and flat caps holding clipboards watch, with other pigs and a striped marquee behind.

en.question: What is the prize pig doing?
